decision_explanation: GO for the finite source comparison, subject to the existing execution gates. Both narrow clarifications below are now explicit in the final protocol. This is not physical, temporal, acoustic or historical acceptance.

reviewed_protocol.review_scope: Dense earlier-copy PTS [10,18), expected indices 300..539; unchanged C0/C2/C4 references and parent image treatment; 720 pairs; two extractions and two scoring runs; no new image or score inspection by this reviewer.

authority_and_inputs.current_user_instructions: Accuracy, explicit assumptions and exclusions, source preservation, falsification and smallest complete authorized change remain controlling.
authority_and_inputs.prior_knowledge: I reviewed the parent candidates and scores previously. This is selected follow-up research on the same sources, not an independent holdout or blind replication.

scope_assessment.appropriate: The fixed window retains padding around the prior first-shot lead without expanding into the unresolved later shot or audio. Reusing the unchanged crop, masks, scales and tie rules avoids result-driven retuning.
scope_assessment.selection_bias: The window and three references are selected using prior results. Dense refinement can narrow an existing file-picture correspondence lead, but cannot supply independent corroboration, source-wide specificity, or a calibrated false-match rate.
scope_assessment.multiple_candidates: 240 adjacent presented frames are correlated, not 240 independent observations. A higher dense maximum or a narrower near-best band is not alone stronger scientific evidence; the candidate pool and geometry search produce those scores.
scope_assessment.strongest_rival: Nearby times and possibly a nearby camera can share static scenery and broad evolving cloud shapes; low resolution, compression and processing can conceal contradictory fine contours. A compelling stationary fit plus an ordered cloud-score peak can therefore remain non-unique.
scope_assessment.contrary_parent_evidence: C4's conspicuous lower advancing cloud favored a neighboring image different from the parent primary dynamic leader, and lies partly outside the frozen upper cloud mask. Keep this discrepancy; do not silently move the mask or substitute a frame to improve a desired sequence.

concise_corrections.issue: Do not interpret duplicate rejection as excluding equal or near-equal image rasters. Repeated presented pictures may be genuine properties of the held derivative.
concise_corrections.required_disposition: Reject duplicate source-index/map entries or broken Cartesian membership, while retaining distinct valid indices even when their pixels repeat. An input-content equality can be reported but must not silently remove a frame.
concise_corrections.does_not_require: Additional historical scoring or new image views.

concise_corrections.category: Reporting clarification; bounded visual coverage remains unchanged
concise_corrections.exact_language_at_issue: inspect the union of the top two static and top two dynamic candidate frames
concise_corrections.issue: Top candidates can be adjacent members of the same highly similar band. This visual shortlist need not represent every near-best band retained numerically.
concise_corrections.required_disposition: Explicitly mark unviewed near-best members/bands unresolved. Do not claim uniqueness, exact sequence identity or rejection of those alternatives merely because the bounded top-two visual shortlist looks convincing.
concise_corrections.does_not_require: Widening the current shortlist or inspecting additional frames; a later expansion would need a separately declared test.

test_plan_assessment.disposition: Proportionate and adequate as a prospective computational plan for the limited comparison; no tests were executed by this method reviewer.
test_plan_assessment.extraction: Exact rational PTS/full-input decoding, two runs, all 240 selected rasters checked against a separate full sequential decode, coarse-overlap equality, current source/helper/runtime pins and origin controls address selection and extraction integrity. Shared decoding infrastructure remains a limitation, not historical independence.
test_plan_assessment.scoring: Fresh inherited controls and adapter tests, dense-wrapper membership/boundary/rejection tests, all 720 pair memberships, saved-surface top-two checks, retained-transform direct arithmetic and both-run equality test the intended numerical contract.
test_plan_assessment.numerical_ceiling: The checker independently evaluates retained transforms, not every FFT search-surface cell. Passing it does not prove that every unselected geometry was computed independently or that the physical/historical hypothesis is true.
test_plan_assessment.required_execution_gates: Current controls must bind to the final driver/test/protocol/config/dependency/runtime pins; all required tests must actually pass before reliance. Preserve failures; enforce each 600-second and 384-MiB output cap without silently raising it. Verify sources and selected inputs before and after.
test_plan_assessment.freshness_limit: This review reads the protocol and parent records; it does not certify a new driver, tests, execution receipt or score product not yet reviewed.

observable_success_and_stopping.computational_success: Two complete, matching 240-frame extractions and 720-pair score runs satisfying the declared controls/tolerances, or an explicit preserved failure.
observable_success_and_stopping.inferential_success: A source-pinned account of whether distinctive changing image details strengthen, weaken or leave unresolved the first-shot lead, preserving neighboring alternatives, endpoints and contrary details.
observable_success_and_stopping.exact_frame_language: Even compelling file-frame content correspondence is not proof of a unique original-camera exposure: repeated/interpolated/reprocessed frames and a common derivative ancestor remain possible.
observable_success_and_stopping.no_retuning: Boundary leaders or contradictory contours are limits of this fixed stage, not permission to widen the interval, change masks, fit rate or choose convenient alternatives.
observable_success_and_stopping.boundaries: No clock, physical trajectory, capture-speed inference, audio fitting/listening, sound classification, silence, source authentication, cause ranking, scientific/human acceptance, legal promotion, new retrieval, outreach, commit or push.
observable_success_and_stopping.stopping_point: Complete the two-run verification and declared bounded visual review, then report. The full investigation remains incomplete.
